name: image_krea2_turbo
description: Krea 2 Turbo — the 8-step distilled checkpoint of Krea's 12B dense DiT, built for fast, high-quality text-to-image. Distilled from a fully post-trained RL checkpoint, so it yields higher final quality than RAW with lower output variation. Runs the qwen3vl_4b text encoder (CLIP type 'krea2') + qwen_image_vae. 8 euler steps at cfg 1 (guidance distilled out), scheduler simple. The model was trained on short, medium, and long natural-language prompts — detailed, longer prompts give the best quality. LoRAs trained on Krea 2 RAW apply cleanly here. Recommended checkpoint for everyday generation; fp8_scaled fits ~16 GB VRAM. Requires ComfyUI 0.26.0+.

prompt.description: Natural-language text prompt describing the image to generate. Krea 2 was trained on short, medium, and long prompts; detailed, longer prompts produce the best quality. No structured JSON or special syntax required.
